newsitem.title: POLAND: LG GROUP OFFERS TO BUY ALL PETROBANK STOCK.
newsitem.headline: LG GROUP OFFERS TO BUY ALL PETROBANK STOCK.

text.p: LG Investment Holdings BV, a subsidiary of South Korea's LG Group which holds more than 50 percent of Poland's Petrobank SA, announced a public tender offer for the bank's remaining common shares, the Warsaw bourse said on Wednesday.
The bourse said in a statement LG Investment Holdings had announced it would buy Petrobank stock at 12 zlotys per share from all shareholders willing to sell their shares.
The bourse said Citibrokerage SA securities house would be receiving offers from investors from December 20 to January 20.
The bourse said that trade in Petrobank would be suspended on December 19 because of the LG Group announcement.
LG Group bought last month 11,128,250 shares representing 50 percent plus one share in Petrobank, based in the central city of Lodz, at 12 zlotys per share.
Under securities trading law LG Group was obliged to offer to buy up the remaining 11,128,249 shares, including 381,3430 registered shares, from other shareholders.
The statement said that the public tender offer applied to the common bearer shares trading on the exchange.
